kaikki_vikisozluk.e: كَامَخ or كَامِخ • (kāmaḵ or kāmiḵ) m (plural كَوَامِخ (kawāmiḵ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Aramaic כָּמְכָא / ܟܳܡܟܳܐ (kāməḵā), a Middle Iranian borrowing equivalent to Classical Persian کامه (kāma), Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (kʾmk' /⁠kāmag⁠/, “soup, gruel”).
g: a kind of sauce or pickle made of vinegar and sour milk
